name: conflict-code
about: While the PR waits to land, a change to the same file lands on main. GitHub calls the PR conflicting; land tries to merge main into the branch, git reports a real conflict outside docs/, and the item goes back to build naming the file. Nothing is pushed or merged.

steps.text: main's own version of the feature

data.reason: ^Merge conflict with main outside docs/: feature\.txt$

messages.text: ^Back to build: Merge conflict with main outside docs/: feature\.txt$
